common_validated_condition: finite recorded inputs,finite captured output,exact bit-value gate semantics;Arb192 encloses reference and output directly
uncovered: unseen inputs on either side of every branch
large angles beyond chosen artificial box
private Rust run fold for arbitrary lengths

branches.name: matrix_to_angles
branches.mathematical_identity_or_target: For an exact unitary, e^(i[beta+(theta+phi+lambda)/2]) RZ(phi) RY(theta) RZ(lambda) reconstructs M.
branches.numerical_operations: complex mul/sub,abs/sqrt/hypot,atan2,arg,add/sub/div;angles can be ill-conditioned at Euler poles
branches.coverage: actual recorded outputs only;no interval of compiler executions

branches.name: theta_near_zero
branches.mathematical_identity_or_target: theta=0: target=e^(i beta) P(lambda+phi);threshold replacement has a residual and is not exact equality for every near-zero theta.
branches.coverage: actual recorded outputs only;no interval of compiler executions

branches.name: theta_near_halfpi
branches.mathematical_identity_or_target: At mathematical theta=pi/2: e^(i beta) P(phi+pi/2) SX P(lambda-pi/2). IEEE PI and threshold replacement have residuals.
branches.coverage: actual recorded outputs only;no interval of compiler executions

branches.name: theta_near_pi
branches.mathematical_identity_or_target: At theta=pi, shift lambda into phase and phi-lambda;threshold approximation otherwise.
branches.coverage: actual recorded outputs only;no interval of compiler executions

branches.name: phi_or_lambda_flip
branches.mathematical_identity_or_target: With exact pi arithmetic, the PSX parameter target is unchanged by this gauge identity.
branches.coverage: actual recorded outputs only;no interval of compiler executions

branches.name: general_two_SX_or_X
branches.output_actions: theta+=PI;phi+=PI;emit pfun(lambda);X if predicate,else SX;pfun(theta);SX;then pfun(phi)
branches.mathematical_identity_or_target: SX*SX=X exactly;PSX target equals P(phi+pi) SX P(theta+pi) SX P(lambda) times adjusted phase. Near-zero central P is a numerical approximation.
branches.coverage: actual recorded outputs only;no interval of compiler executions

branches.name: RZ_emit_or_omit
branches.mathematical_identity_or_target: P(p)=exp(i p/2) RZ(p). Omitting the pair approximates P(p),not RZ(p) alone.
branches.coverage: actual recorded outputs only;no interval of compiler executions

branches.name: mod_endpoint
branches.phase_actions: reduced parameter is also used by phase contribution
branches.mathematical_identity_or_target: P(a+2pi k)=P(a);RZ(a+2pi k)=(-1)^k RZ(a),so phase and RZ cannot be separated. Endpoint clamp is approximate near the cut.
branches.coverage: actual recorded outputs only;no interval of compiler executions

branches.name: accepted_vs_rejected_rewrite
branches.output_actions: target=None,basis-closed,ZSXX only -> strict gate-count reduction;rejected candidate leaves old run
branches.mathematical_identity_or_target: Use identity for rejected run and direct ideal-run-to-returned-word residual for accepted run;unknown accept decisions require coverage of both possible outputs.
branches.coverage: actual recorded outputs only;no interval of compiler executions
